verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹੁਰੁ ਪੀਹਰੁ ਪਖ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਘਰੁ ਨਾਨੇਹਾਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: saahur peehar pakh trai ghar naanehaalaa|

en.bdb: There are three types of relationship - first those of father, mother, sister, brother and their offspring and alliances;

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਹੁਰਾ ਸਸੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਸਾਲੀ ਤੈ ਸਾਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: sahuraa sas vakhaaneeaai saalee tai saalaa|

en.bdb: Second, mother's father, mother's mother, mother's sisters, mother's brothers;

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾ ਪਿਉ ਭੈਣਾਂ ਭਾਇਰਾ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ਦੁਰਾਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: maa piau bhainaa(n) bhairaa paravaar dhuraalaa|

en.bdb: Third, father-in-law, mother-in-law, brother-in-law, and sister-in-law.
For them, gold, silver, diamonds, and corals are amassed.
But dearer than all is the love of the Guru's Sikhs for the Guru,

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੀਰ ਮੁਰੀਦਾਂ ਪਿਰਹੜੀ ਏਹੁ ਸਾਕੁ ਸੁਖਾਲਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit_en: peer mureedhaa(n) pirahaRee eh saak sukhaalaa ||7||

en.bdb: And, this is the relationship which brings happiness.
